lastResponse.text: First step: call nine one one right now. You’re shaky after missing insulin, and your phone is at three percent, so this is urgent. I’ll say it again slowly: 9 … 1 … 1. If you can, put the phone on speaker while you dial so we save battery.
originalTexts: First step: call **9-1-1** right now. You’re shaky after missing insulin, and your phone is at 3%, so this is urgent. I’ll say it again slowly: **9 … 1 … 1**. If you can, put the phone on speaker while you dial so we save battery.
